title: Beyond Preferences: Learning Alignment Principles Grounded in Human Reasons and Values
reasoning: The paper focuses on the ethical alignment of Large Language Models, specifically proposing a framework (GCAI) to elicit principles grounded in human reasons and values. It explicitly evaluates AI constitutions based on 'Moral Grounding,' 'ethics,' and 'fairness,' and uses benchmarks like the Social Bias BBQ to measure stereotyping.
